LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription: Aerial_Knight’s Dropshot is a fast, stylish action shooter that throws you straight out of a plane and into the chaos. Take out enemies, dodge wild traps, and make it to the ground first. Filled with finger blasting, Dragons, Powerups, and a bunch of stuff trying to take you down midair. Don't let anything get in your way of becoming a legend! Just try to look cool & land in one piece!
LocalizedProperties.ShortDescription: Dropshot is a fast-paced, stylized FPS where you face off against enemies to grab a parachute and land first. Armed with limited "Finger Gun" bullets, outsmart enemies, avoid fire, and use slipstreams to survive. Only one will make it.

Features: Intense Soundtrack: Pulse-pounding music and sound effects with some style
Dynamic Visuals: Stunning environments and thrilling perspectives as you plummet toward the earth.
Quick Rounds: Each round lasts 30-45 seconds — fast-paced action that never lets up.
Boss Battles: Face off against massive, over-the-top bosses in midair.
Race Challenges: Go head-to-head with your persistent rival in a high-speed dive
A story that you wont care about
LocalizedProperties.MinimumNotes: Storage: 7 GB available space;OS: Windows 10 or better;Memory: 4 GB RAM;Graphics: Nvidia GTX 660 or similar
